==About==

A {{i|Darkwater Bluegill}} can be dried on a {{i|Drying Frame}} for 72 hours to make a {{i|Dried Darkwater Bluegill}}. Due to the current nature of the most recent Fish rework there is no reason to ever make a Dried Darkwater Bluegill.
